paite: Unaute aw, Pathian thuguk noute hon hilh ding a na kiang ua ka hong lai in thugen thupi leh pilna thupi toh ka hong pai kei hi.
heading: Pilna Leh Kilakna

paite: Jesu Khrist, amah mah kilhden a om thu kia lou ngal na lak uah bangmah theih ka tum kei hi.
Hat lou leh lau in, nakpitak a ling kawm in na lak uah ka om hi.
Ka paukam suak leh ka thugente thupil a khemna thu ahi kei a, Kha leh thilhihtheihna theihsakna in ahi zaw hi.
Huchi a na ginna uh mihing pilna a kinga lou a, Pathian thilhihtheihna a kinga a a-om zawk theihna ding in.
Himahleh pichingte lak ah ahihleh thupil i hilh zel a, hinapi in hiai khovel thupil zaw ahi kei; hiai khovel vaihawmte mangthang dingte thupil leng ahi sam kei hi;
Pathian pilna guk leh kisel, i thupina ding a Pathian in khovel om ma a asehkholhsa pen i hilh zaw nak hi.
Hiai khovel vaihawmte himhim in athei kei uh; thei le uh zaw thupina Toupa kilhden lou ding hi ve un.
"Mit a muh ngei louh, bil a zak ngei louh, mihing lungtang a lut ngei lou, Pathian in amah itte a dia abawl," chih gelh bang in.
Pathian in Kha in huaite ei ahon theisakta a; Kha in bangkim asuikhe vek a; Pathian thugilte tan in.
Mihing ngaihtuahte mihing sung a om kha mah lou in, kua'n ahia thei ding? Huchi mah bang in Pathian ngaihtuahte Pathian Kha mah lou kuamah in athei kei uhi.
Huan athawn a Pathian in thil hon piakte i theihna ding in, eite'n zaw khovel kha hilou in, Kha, Pathian a kipan ngei i mu zaw uhi.
Mihing' pilna a sinsak thute a hilh lou in Kha sinsak in i hilh zaw ua, Kha neite kiang ah khalam thutakte i hilhchian uhi.
Khovel mi'n Pathian Kha thilpiakte asang kei nak hi, amah ngaihdan in haihuai ahi ngal a, kha a theihchet ahih ziak in atheithei kei hi.
Khami in bel thil bangkim achian zel a, amah lah kuamahi achian kei uhi.
"Kua'n ahia Toupa lungsim thei khin a, amah thuhilh thei ding?" Eite'n bel Khrist lungsim i pu uhi.
